note: O'Brien County Conservation park on Dog Creek Lake, 2 mi southeast of Sutherland along the Glacial Trail Scenic Byway, with a swimming beach, fishing jetty, boat ramp, hiking trails and grain-bin cabins. Two campgrounds, both set back in the trees from the lake: North off the north lane near Warbler Ave and South on the park road's west loop with back-in spurs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 low (north sites), 29 sites. Fees high 20 -> 28 (south sites 19-24 on the calendar), reservation_fee 4. Added water hookups, reservable on MyCountyParks, showers/flush/vault/dump/potable water, season May 1 - Oct 14. Note cleaned. Stays not waterfront.
flags: CHANGED: fees.nightly_high 20 -> 28. The booking calendar charges $28 for south sites 19-24 although their own fee lines still read '$20 per night'; north sites 1-16 are $20 (low unchanged). Site 25 (seasonal lease) lists $25.

HOOKUPS: electric present at every site but no amperage is posted, so hookups.electric is left unset. The map says sites 24-29 are full hookup, but #24 is the only one of those on the nightly calendar (#25 is a seasonal lease, 26-29 not listed), so sewer is left unset rather than written true on one public site.
FIT OK (imagery estimate): the south loop's back-in spurs measure about 18-20 m on NAIP (0.2 m/px); the north sites are under trees. No length limit is posted.

WATERFRONT: Dog Creek Lake is well over 5 acres, but neither campground reaches it. The north campground is about 160 m from the shore with woods and an open meadow (cabins and trails) between; the south campground is about 300 m from the nearest arm through woods. Distances are NAIP estimates; Overpass was down this session (private.coffee timed out, overpass-api.de 406). The park page's 'breathtaking view of the lake and valley' is about the park, not the sites. Confirms not waterfront.

PIN: 42.93552,-95.47282 is about 120 m east of the south campground's spurs (42.93545,-95.47425), so it's within tolerance. The larger north campground (sites 1-18, showers, dump) is at about 42.94031,-95.46830, ~650 m away; optional re-pin there if the entry should point at the main campground.
